brief:
Israeli forces have conducted near-daily attacks on Lebanon since a ceasefire agreement in November 2024, according to Dawn. The attacks have prompted accusations of systematic war crimes, with observers pointing to what they describe as the "Gaza model" of military operations being replicated in Lebanese territory.

Media coverage of the escalation has drawn criticism for framing Israeli military actions as reactive rather than as an ongoing campaign. A CNN headline characterizing Hezbollah as restarting conflict came days after the U.S. and Israel launched military operations against Iran, according to the report.
dek: On March 2, 2026, just days after the United States and Israel launched another illegal war on Iran and assassinated Iranian officials, including supreme leader Ali Khamenei, CNN ran a headline that said, “Hezbollah just restarted the fight that Israel was waiting to finish.” It was a remarkable statement, given Israel had conducted near-daily attacks on Lebanon since a so-called ceasefire in November 2024 while…
title: Israel's conduct in Lebanon breaches war crimes law, critics say
